calibration_decision.rule: adopt a calibrator for a market only if, on the block's primary test window, held-out log loss improves with a paired-bootstrap CI that excludes zero; other windows are supporting checks. 56 market x method x window tests were run, so isolated hits are expected by chance and the verdicts differ across windows.
